name: EntityKind
lead: One kind the game version has, in its own numbers, from `game.entities.<kind>`: name, size, max_health, speed and drop. A kind that is not a mob (an arrow, a boat, primed TNT; `mob == false`) has `name`, `mob`, `width`, `height` and `physics` only: every other fact is nil for it, and a write to `spawn`, `attacks` or `interact` and a call of `amend` are errors.

fields.name: mob
fields.description: Whether the kind is a mob: true for a cow, false for an arrow.

fields.name: physics
fields.description: For a kind that is not a mob, which order of operations moves it: "item", "falling", "vehicle" or "none". Nil for a mob kind.

fields.name: behaviour
fields.description: The name of the behaviour the engine runs for this kind, such as "sheep" or "living".

fields.name: profile
fields.description: Read-only copy; nil for a specialized behavior without a shared profile.

fields.name: registry_name
fields.description: This version's own registry spelling: "Cow". A dungeon spawner stores this one.

fields.name: width
fields.description: Its width in blocks, in this version's numbers.

fields.name: height
fields.description: Its height in blocks, in this version's numbers.

fields.name: max_health
fields.description: The most health one of this kind has, in this version's numbers. `health` on a kind is an error: health is what one entity has now.

fields.name: speed
fields.description: Blocks a tick at a full walk.

fields.name: drop
fields.description: The item its death leaves behind, such as "leather"; nil for none.

fields.name: spawn
fields.description: The one writable field. `true`: the kind is in this world as the game defines it: it spawns by the game's own rule, also on a `mode: lite` world, and `attacks` and `interact` are on for it unless a pack sets them; an error on a 1.8.9 world with no biomes, where nothing would spawn it. `false`: the kind never spawns by itself in this world; spawner blocks, `world.spawn`, `/summon` and breeding still make it. `nil`: the pack says nothing and the world's default applies: no natural spawning on a `mode: lite` world and in a room from `rooms.create`, the game's own rule on a `mode: full` world and after `world.rules{ survival = true }`. A table is an error today. Reads what this pack set (`true`, `false` or nil), not the game's own rule. The value is this room's (`room.game.entities.cow.spawn`) and this pack's: a `false` of any pack wins. Every write is an error on a game with no natural spawning (a0.1.0 to a0.1.3).

fields.name: attacks
fields.description: Whether its hits hurt players. `nil`: on for a kind with `spawn = true`, else the room's `damage` rule. The kind's own setting is stronger than the room's rule. It covers the kind's own hit, its arrow (also after the shooter died) and a creeper's blast. `false` stops the damage to players only: a blast still breaks blocks.

fields.name: interact
fields.description: Whether a player's right click on it has the game's effect (milk, a saddle). `nil`: on for a kind with `spawn = true`, else the room's `survival`. `true` is an error on 1.8.9, which has no right click on a mob.

title: EntityKind type
